positive_statements_checked.quote: These VGPR MSBs remain in effect until the next S_SET_VGPR_MSB instruction or modification of the MODE hardware register.
The MSBs only applies to operands that are VGPRs. They are ignored for SGPR, inline constant and other operand types.
There are 8 MODE register bits associated with each wave that are applied to vector instructions to supply the MSBits of the VGPR address:
Privileged mode. Indicates that the wave is in the trap handler. Gives write access to TTMP registers.
When a trap is taken (either user initiated, exception or host initiated), the shader hardware generates an S_TRAP instruction.
<wait for outstanding instructions to finish> { TTMP1, TTMP0 } = {TrapID[3:0], zeros, PC[56:0]} // TrapID=0 unless the exception is "S_TRAP" PC = TBA (trap base address) PRIV = 1
for reads or atomic-with-return, it means the return data is available in VGPRs.
Overrides EXEC mask for the VGPR read.
Overrides EXEC mask for the VGPR write.

closed_S_TRAP_summary: Jump to the trap handler and pass in 4-bit TRAP id from SIMM[3:0]. <wait for outstanding instructions to finish> { TTMP1, TTMP0 } = {TrapID[3:0], zeros, PC[56:0]} // TrapID=0 unless the exception is "S_TRAP" PC = TBA (trap base address) PRIV = 1 Host traps cause the shader hardware to generate an S_TRAP instruction. Note: the save-PC points to the S_TRAP instruction. TRAPID 0 is reserved and should not be used.
closed_S_TRAP_detail: Enter the trap handler. This instruction may be generated internally as well in response to a host trap (TrapID = 0) or an exception. TrapID 0 is reserved for hardware use and should not be used in a shader-generated trap. Expression TrapID = SIMM16.u16[3 : 0].u8; "Wait for all instructions to complete"; // PC passed into trap handler points to S_TRAP itself, // *not* to the next instruction. { TTMP[1], TTMP[0] } = { TrapID[3 : 0], 12'0, PC[47 : 0] }; PC = TBA.i64; // trap base address WAVE_STATUS.PRIV = 1'1U

whole_document_exception_screen.method: Search each trap/privileged/PRIV word with 160 characters on each side for exact bank-state terms.
whole_document_exception_screen.inference_scope: No matching documented exception found by this explicit screen; negative search is supporting evidence only.

conclusions: The explicit persistence rule plus the documented S_TRAP state transitions support preservation of incoming VGPR bank state until handler code changes MODE or executes another setter.
The same general bank rules apply to the early vector operands in the documented model. The inspected privilege definition and bank exceptions do not supply a privileged bypass.
This is a normative execution-model conclusion. It does not measure installed hardware behavior, prove a trap occurred in a failing invocation, or establish the original training NaN cause.
For the installed entry words inherited from the pinned full-byte certificate, low setter81/85 therefore predicts the lane0 v257-to-v513 copy under the published contract.

downstream_geometry_supplement.refined_completion_condition: If a trap is actually taken after the relevant LDS instruction and before the operand is overwritten, documented S_TRAP draining completes that LDS load before the early handler copy. The request need not arrive after the LDS load has already completed.

limits: Official download provenance is rehashed from the other agent; this review does not perform a second network retrieval.
PRIV has several documented privileges elsewhere, so its definition is not treated as an exhaustive list of all privilege effects.
Installed entry bytes, byte decoding and source-to-installed-module binding inherit the pinned independent entry certificate.
The 57-bit summary and legacy48-bit detailed PC forms differ in the manual; this does not alter the bank-preservation argument.
A hardware measurement remains required to distinguish conformance to this documented model from an undocumented reset or override.
